summary.en: With time running thin, Conan and the Detective Boys followed clues left behind Akio's drawings and Kenzo stated his grandson's habit of providing his signature on an object he found appealing. In response, Conan quickly run to the scene where Akio drew that object and his team followed, in all turn of events, Ayumi in now with the kidnapper. What will happen to her and Akio? Victim: Akio Tsubakuro Kidnapper bought crayon and sandwich to Akio.
